title: Semolina Polenta with Wild Mushrooms
subtitle: with parmesan and nutmeg
description: Creamy semolina porridge with parmesan and nutmeg, served with seared mixed wild mushrooms.

steps.text: Heat a dry frying pan over high heat, add the mushrooms and sear for 5 to 10 minutes (depending on size) until they begin to char. Add the olive oil and chopped garlic, stir and fry for about 1 minute until golden. Turn off the heat, season with lemon juice, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper, stir and set aside.

Bring the water and milk to the boil in a medium pot. Add the semolina, stirring, and cook at a gentle bubble for about 5 minutes until it starts to thicken. Season with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper and the nutmeg and cook over low heat for about 10 more minutes, stirring occasionally, until very soft and thick. Turn off the heat, add the parmesan and stir until it melts.
Place about four heaped tablespoons of polenta and two of mushrooms on each plate, season with flaky salt and black pepper and serve immediately.
